candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition with true, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll.
Delete the require statement, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll.
Replace the recipient address with a constant zero address, so funds are sent to address(0) and burned instead of the given recipient.
Replace address(this).balance with 0, so the transfer sends zero wei regardless of actual balance.
Insert a selfdestruct before the transfer, destroying the contract and sending remaining balance to the recipient, changing the final state of withdrawAll behavior.
Move the require statement after the transfer, allowing the transfer to occur before the ownership check, changing the observable outcome if called by non-owner.
